Subject: 🚀 [Register NOW] Chinese Enterprise Career Fair Series 26/27 – 2026 Asia-Pacific Talent Professional Development Forum (26 Nov) | 🚀「立即報名」中國企業招聘會系列 26/27 – 2026 亞太人才職業發展論壇 (11月26日)


To: Students of the College of Computing





Explore Career Opportunities in Shanghai: Meet 14 Leading Employers & Explore 280+ Career Opportunities on Campus



Representatives from 14 leading enterprises in Shanghai will visit CityUHK to share 280+ career opportunities across a wide range of disciplines, including AI and Technology, Biomedicine, Engineering, Finance, Education and Scientific Research.



All CityUHK students are welcome to join and learn about career prospects and engage directly with recruiters.



Event Details

Date: 26 November 2026 (Thu)

Time & Venue:

  *   Career Talk at Joseph Lee Hall (LI-3505): 1:00pm – 2:00pm
  *   Employer Networking at 2/F Classrooms, LI Building: 2:00pm – 4:30pm



Register NOW

  *   AIMS → Student Services → CRESDA (or simply click HERE<https://banweb.cityu.edu.hk/pls/PROD/twgkpswd_cityu.P_WWWLogin?to_url=CRESDA_CSS.P_CSS700%3Fp_act_id=13119%26back_funcid=CSS600%26p_action=view_act>)
  *   Deadline: 25 November 2026 (Wed), 5:00pm



Meet employers, submit your CV, and unlock career opportunities. Register now before places fill up!



Best Regards,

Career and Leadership Centre

Student Development Services

City University of Hong Kong





與14家上海知名企業面對面交流 – 280+職位空缺等你申請!



來自上海的 14家知名企業將親臨城大，帶來 280+個職位空缺，涵蓋人工智能與科技、生物醫藥、工程、金融、教育及科研等熱門領域。

歡迎所有城大學生參加，把握機會了解上海的就業前景，並直接與企業招聘代表交流。



活動詳情

日期：2026年11月26日（星期四）

時間及地點：

  *   企業宣講：下午1時至2時 / 李達三葉耀珍學術樓三樓李宗德講堂（LI-3505）
  *   僱主交流：下午2時至4時30分 / 李達三葉耀珍學術樓二樓課室



立即報名

AIMS → Student Services → CRESDA (或直接按此處<https://banweb.cityu.edu.hk/pls/PROD/twgkpswd_cityu.P_WWWLogin?to_url=CRESDA_CSS.P_CSS700%3Fp_act_id=13119%26back_funcid=CSS600%26p_action=view_act>報名)

截止報名：2026年11月25日（星期三）下午5時正



把握與企業面對面交流的難得機會，拓展職業發展視野，為未來事業發展搶佔先機，立即報名！
